## TemplateEngine.validateBlockImportAttributes() method

Validates attributes on `<import>` blocks.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static validateBlockImportAttributes(template: string): {
        valid: boolean;
        errors: Array<{
            line: number;
            message: string;
        }>;
    };
```

</tbody></table>

**Returns:**

{ valid: boolean; errors: Array&lt;{ line: number; message: string; }&gt;; }

An object with a `valid` boolean and an `errors` array

## Remarks

Allowed attributes are `src`<!-- -->, `block`<!-- -->, `base`<!-- -->, `lang`<!-- -->, and `section`<!-- -->.

## Example


```typescript
const result = TemplateEngine.validateBlockImportAttributes(`<import src="other" block="message" />`);
// Result: { valid: true, errors: [] }
```
